## ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 API

ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 is a text-to-speech model by ElevenLabs, available on the Venice API as `elevenlabs-tts-multilingual-v2`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Multilingual text-to-speech using ElevenLabs. Supports 29 languages with high-quality natural-sounding voices, configurable speed, and accent accuracy.

### ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elevenlabs-tts-multilingual-v2` | Standard | Anonymized | $115 / 1M chars |

### How to use the ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue` with `"model": "elevenlabs-tts-multilingual-v2"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "elevenlabs-tts-multilingual-v2",
    "prompt": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'

# 2. Retrieve when ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "elevenlabs-tts-multilingual-v2", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output audio.mp3
```
